mainEntity.name: What common challenges should I anticipate during a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a whole-home remodel, anticipate potential challenges such as unexpected structural issues discovered during demolition, which can lead to delays and increased costs. Material shortages or shipping delays can also impact project timelines. Communication breakdowns with contractors or subcontractors are another common hurdle if not managed proactively. Living through the disruption, including noise, dust, and temporary loss of utilities, requires patience. Establishing clear communication channels, building contingency into the budget, and having realistic expectations can help mitigate these challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Anticipate challenges like unexpected structural issues, material delays, and communication breakdowns during a remodel. Noise, dust, and utility disruptions are also common, requiring patience and clear planning.
